festivals.name: Kartik Purnima Mahapooja & 1008 Deepotsav
festivals.description: Auspicious Dev Diwali celebrations featuring special Shringar of Maa Vaishno Bhavtarni, 1008 pure cow ghee earthen lamps illumination, Maha Aarti, and distribution of Kheer Prasad.

festivals.name: Divya Mata Ki Chowki & Akhand Bhajan Sandhya
festivals.description: Soul-stirring devotional bhajans by renowned bhajan mandalis, Akhand Jyot Darshan, floral offerings at Maa's lotus feet, Ardaas prayer, and 56 Bhog Mahaprasad.

festivals.name: Magha Gupt Navratri Mahotsav
festivals.description: Sacred period for internal spiritual sadhana, Durga Saptashati parayan, Hawan, and special evening aartis seeking divine protection and strength.

festivals.name: Maha Shivratri Mahotsav & Akhand Rudrabhishek
festivals.timings: All-Night 4-Prahar Pujan (6:00 AM – Next Morning 6:00 AM)
festivals.description: Auspicious Shiva-Shakti union celebration featuring continuous Vedic Rudrabhishek, 1008 Bilvapatra archana, milk & honey panchamrit abhishek, and devotional Shiv-Durga aarti.

festivals.name: Annual Mandir Sthapna Diwas & Patotsav
festivals.description: Commemorating the holy Pran Pratishtha of Adi Shakti Maa Vaishno Bhavtarni with 108 Kalash Pujan, Maha Yagya, Flag hoisting (Dhwajarohan), and Community Mahaprasad for all devotees.

festivals.name: Hanuman Jayanti & Sangeetmay Sundarkand Path
festivals.description: Celebration of Shri Hanuman Janmotsav with musical recitation of Shri Sundarkand, sacred Sindoor chola offering, 108 Hanuman Chalisa chanting, and Boondi Mahaprasad distribution.

festivals.name: Chaitra Navratri Mahotsav & Ram Navami
festivals.description: Nine sacred days of devotion featuring Ghatasthapana, Akhand Jyot, daily Chandi Path, special floral shringar of Maa Bhavtarni, and grand Kanya Pujan on Ram Navami.

festivals.name: Weekly Tuesday & Saturday Maa Ki Aarti & Kirtan
festivals.description: Weekly community devotional gathering where devotees join in traditional dholak, chimta, and harmonium accompanied bhajan kirtan followed by Halwa and Chana prasad.

festivals.name: Vasant Panchami & Saraswati Devi Avahan
festivals.description: Welcoming the auspicious spring season with yellow floral shringar of Maa Vaishno, Saraswati Pujan, book and pen blessings for students, and sweet saffron Kesari prasad.

festivals.name: Guru Purnima & Sacred Charan Paduka Archana
festivals.description: Special day of gratitude dedicated to the divine lineage and Charan Paduka worship. Devotees offer Panchamrit snan, sandalwood paste, and fragrant flower garlands at Maa's holy lotus feet.

festivals.name: Kojagiri (Sharad) Purnima Amrit Kheer Utsav
festivals.description: Sacred Kojagiri night celebrations with moonlight bhajan sandhya, Lakshmi-Vaishno pujan, and distribution of saffron-cardamom Amrit Kheer kept under the nectar-raining full moon.

festivals.name: Sharad Navratri Mahotsav
festivals.description: The most magnificent autumn festival at the temple with 9 days of royal poshak shringar, Tridevi Mahapooja, Dandiya Raas, and thousands of devotees seeking Maa's blessings.

festivals.name: Vijayadashami / Dussehra Utsav
festivals.description: Commemorating the victory of Maa Durga over Mahishasura and righteousness over unrighteousness. Featuring Shastra Pujan, Aparajita Pujan, and distribution of holy Prasad.
